description: Samsung Galaxy Z TriFold 2 will be equipped with a special slot for the S-Pen stylus, which will be placed inside the hinge of the foldable, according to a patent-based leak. Moreover, the design of the rumoured twice-folding smartphone has been spotted in purported renders. The images suggest that the S-Pen stylus pocket will be placed inside the right hinge of the handset. The selfie camera appears on the right flap of the rumoured Galaxy Z TriFold 2, which is identical to last year’s Galaxy Z TriFold. The handset appears in a purple colourway.
title: Samsung Patent Application Suggests Galaxy Z TriFold 2 Could Launch With an S-Pen Housed Inside Its Hinge

description: Samsung has announced its Certified Re-Newed programme in India. The programme brings refurbished Galaxy devices, including flagship and mid-range models, to consumers at reduced prices. Samsung is currently selling Certified Re-Newed Galaxy S25 series phones and Galaxy A56 smartphones under the programme. The phones have the latest software installed, and come with the same one-year warranty as new devices.
title: Samsung Launches Certified Re-Newed Programme in India; Offers Refurbished Galaxy S25, Galaxy A56 Models

description: WhatsApp has reportedly started rolling out WhatsApp Plus to some iPhone users. The paid subscription adds premium stickers, 18 accent colours, 14 app icons, 10 exclusive ringtones, and the ability to pin up to 20 chats. It is available on WhatsApp for iOS version 26.17.74 and is priced at EUR 2.49 (roughly Rs. 274) per month in some regions. Standard messaging and calling features remain free for all users.
title: WhatsApp Plus Rolls Out to iOS Users With Premium Stickers, Themes and More

description: MediaTek may launch the Dimensity 8600 later this year as a major upgrade to its upper mid-range chipset lineup. According to a tipster, the chip will use a 3nm process and a redesigned architecture. Oppo, Vivo, Xiaomi, and Honor are said to be testing devices powered by the new processor. Some of these phones could feature batteries larger than 10,000mAh. Honor Power 3 is tipped as one possible model that may debut with the Dimensity 8600.
title: MediaTek Dimensity 8600 Leak Suggests It Will Be a 3nm Chip, Could Arrive on Phones With 10,000mAh Batteries

description: Sony is reportedly sendind emails to PS4 users suggesting them to upgrade to PS5 if they wish to play GTA 6. Several users who had GTA 6 on their wishlists or have played GTA 5 reported received the communication from PlayStation over the weekend.
title: GTA 6 Third Trailer Rumours Gather Steam After Sony Asks PS4 Users to Upgrade to PS5 Ahead of Launch

description: Samsung has reportedly begun rolling out the stable One UI 8.5 update for the Galaxy S25 lineup in the US. The Android 16-based software was first released in South Korea last week. The update introduces several new features to the Galaxy S25 series that were initially limited to the newer Galaxy S26 lineup.
title: Samsung Galaxy S25 Series Gets One UI 8.5 Update Globally, Including India

description: Printers continue to be an essential part of homes and workspaces. From printing school assignments and office documents to handling invoices, forms, and photographs, its use cases are plentiful. So, if you’re searching for a new printer, then the Amazon Great Summer Sale 2026 brings discounts on a wide range of printers from brands such as HP, Canon, Epson, and Brother. Alongside price cuts, you can also avail of additional bank offers, cashback benefits, and EMI options.
title: Amazon Great Summer Sale 2026: Best Deals on Printers From Brands Like Canon, Epson and HP

It brings discounts on a wide range of products across smartphones, laptops, tablets, smartwatches, earphones, speakers, smart TVs, home appliances, and more. Just like each year, consumers can expect direct discounts and bank offers, while Prime subscribers will get exclusive deals and more.
title: Amazon Great Summer Sale 2026: Best Deals on 2-in-1 Laptops

The e-commerce giant currently offers discounts of up to 75 percent on select models from brands such as boAt, Redmi, Noise, Pebble, and Fire-Boltt. title: Amazon Great Summer Sale 2026: Top Deals and Discounts on Budget Smartwatches

Featured deals include the boAt Aavante 2.2 1400 at Rs. 4,499 and the Zebronics Juke BAR 200A at Rs. 3,298. Buyers can also avail of HDFC Bank discounts, cashback, no-cost EMI, and exchange offers, while Prime members get extra coupons and additional cashback benefits.
title: Amazon Great Summer Sale 2026: Best Deals and Offers on Budget Soundbars During the Sale

description: HP has introduced the HP OmniPad 12 in India. The new tablet, designed for entry-level users and students, offers a dual-mode experience. It comes with a detachable keyboard that allows users to switch between tablet and laptop modes. The price of the new device starts at Rs. 48,999 in India. It will go on sale in the country from June across the HP online store, Amazon, Reliance and HP World stores.
title: HP OmniPad 12 Launched in India With Snapdragon Chipset, Detachable Keyboard

description: HP has refreshed its OmniBook lineup in India, the tech giant announced on Monday. Three models in the series, including the HP OmniBook Ultra 14 (2026), OmniBook X (2026), and OmniBook 5 (2026), have been launched in the country. The new laptops are currently available for purchase in India via the company’s online store and the HP authorised offline retail stores. The flagship HP OmniBook Ultra 14 (2026) can be purchased with either an Intel Ultra processor or Qualcomm’s Snapdragon X series processor. Meanwhile, the OmniBook X (2026) and OmniBook 5 (2026) are only available in Intel Ultra processor configurations.
title: HP OmniBook Ultra 14 (2026), OmniBook X (2026) and OmniBook 5 (2026) Launched in India With Intel, Snapdragon Chips

description: Amazon Great Summer Sale 2026 is offering discounts on several smart TVs priced under Rs. 30,000. Featured deals include the LG 43-inch 4K webOS TV at Rs. 28,240, TCL 55-inch 4K QLED Google TV at Rs. 27,240, and Samsung 43-inch Vision AI QLED TV at Rs. 26,902. Prime members can access extra cashback and coupons, while all shoppers can avail of HDFC Bank discounts, no-cost EMI, exchange offers, and cashback on eligible purchases.
title: Amazon Great Summer Sale 2026: Best Deals on Smart TVs Under Rs 30,000

description: HMD Vibe 2 5G will be launched in India on May 21, the smartphone maker has confirmed. The handset will go on sale in the country via Flipkart in Cosmic Lavender, Nordic Blue, and Peach Pink colour options. Moreover, the upcoming HMD Vibe 2 5G is confirmed to feature a dual rear camera unit, led by a 50-megapixel AI camera, coupled with an unspecified secondary shooter. The smartphone will be backed by a 6,000mAh battery and feature support for 18W wired charging. This means that it will debut with a notably larger battery than its predecessor, which packs a 5,000mAh cell.
title: HMD Vibe 2 5G India Launch Date Revealed Along With Design, Colourways and Key Specifications

description: Amazon Great Summer Sale 2026 is currently live in India. Amazon has several great choices in the 50-inch screen models in the ongoing sale. Customers can also use their HDFC cards to get an additional up to 10 percent instant discount. Further, the online marketplace is offering coupon-based discounts and Amazon Pay offers.
title: Amazon Great Summer Sale 2026: Best Deals on 50-Inch Smart TVs From Samsung, Sony and More

description: HP has launched the EliteBook X G2 series, EliteBook 8 G2 series, and ProBook 4 G2 series in India. The new business laptops are powered by Intel, AMD, and Qualcomm processors and offer up to 85 TOPS of AI performance. They also include HP Wolf Security and HP Sure View privacy features. Prices start at Rs. 1,35,000 for the ProBook 4 G2 series, Rs. 2,30,000 for the EliteBook 8 G2 series, and Rs. 2,50,000 for the EliteBook X G2 series.
title: HP EliteBook X G2, EliteBook 8 G2 and ProBook 4 G2 AI PCs Launched in India

description: Anthropic has finally revealed the reason its artificial intelligence (AI) models exhibited harmful behaviour in a simulation last year. The San Francisco-based AI startup claimed that the Claude 4 series models blackmailed users into completing the objective because of training data that portrayed AI as evil.
title: Anthropic Reveals Text Portraying AI as Evil Triggered Claude’s Attempt at Blackmail

description: Developer Cold Iron Studios and publisher Daybreak Game Company have announced Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2, a sequel to co-op shooter Aliens: Fireteam Elite. The game will feature up to four-player co-op, new classes, weapons, and more dangerous Alien threats. Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2
title: Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 Announced for PC and Consoles, Will Launch This Summer

description: iQOO 15T is expected to launch in China on May 20 alongside the iQOO Pad 6 Pro and TWS 5i. A leak from a tipster claims the phone will use a custom Dimensity 9500 "Monster" edition chip and Q3 gaming chip. A China Telecom listing suggests it will feature a 6.82-inch 2K 144Hz OLED display, 200-megapixel dual rear cameras, a 16-megapixel selfie camera, and an 8,000mAh battery with 100W wired charging.
title: iQOO 15T Tipped to Launch With Custom Dimensity 9500 Chip; China Telecom Listing Reveals Key Specifications

description: Redmi's upcoming K100 series may not include a Pro Max model. A new leak coming out of China suggests that Redmi has scrapped the Q11U model, which is said to be associated with the Redmi K100 Pro Max. The brand is said to be working on a new device, codenamed Q11X. It is expected to be launched alongside the standard Redmi K100 Pro.
title: Redmi K100 Pro Max to Make Way for All-New Flagship Variant This Year, Tipster Claims

description: Forza Horizon 6 has reportedly leaked ahead of its launch. The racing title's game files reportedly leaked via steam, and a playable PC build of the game has surfaced online. Forza Horizon 6 is set to launch on PC and Xbox Series S/X on May 19. It will arrive later this year on PS5.
title: Forza Horizon 6 Reportedly Leaks on Steam Days Ahead of Launch

description: Apple has begun testing the new automatic tabs grouping feature for its native browser Safari, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman writes in the latest edition of his weekly newsletter ‘Power On’. The new functionality on Safari is said to be similar to the tabs organisation feature on Google Chrome. While users can currently group tabs manually, based on their preferences and usage, the upcoming tool will reportedly group all the tabs automatically, eliminating the need to create groups and organise tabs manually. The feature is expected to roll out to iPhone and iPad models, along with Mac devices with the upcoming iOS 27, iPadOS 27, and macOS 27 updates.
title: Apple's iOS 27, macOS 27 Updates Will Reportedly Introduce Automatic Tab Grouping on Safari
Samsung Galaxy A57 5G: Built for Everyday Use

description: Apple’s Liquid Glass push has been in the news for some time now. Released with iOS 27 and related software updates, it brings a fresh visual makeover, with glass-like elements in the UI. While it has appealed to some, others have called it a Windows Vista-lookalike, along with the corresponding problems that came along with it. As per a seasoned journalist, the Cupertino-based tech giant is preparing a refined version of its Liquid Glass interface with macOS 27. It is said to focus on improving readability, polishing transparency effects, and fixing visual inconsistencies.
title: macOS 27 to Reportedly Feature Big Changes With Liquid Glass Refinements, Better Readability

description: Lenovo is once again entering the gaming smartphone category with the Lenovo Legion Y70 (2026). Ahead of launch, the company has been teasing several details about the upcoming handset, including its Snapdragon 8 series chipset and thermal management capabilities. The handset has now surfaced on a benchmarking platform, which sheds light on some of its other key specifications. The Lenovo Legion Y70 (2026) is expected to ship with up to 16GB of RAM.
title: Lenovo Legion Y70 (2026) With Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 Surfaces on Geekbench Ahead of China Launch
